title: Executive Decisions
description: Heidelberg Materials CEO Dominik von Achten reflects on his path from law to leadership, why listening to younger voices is vital when navigating rapid change, and how turning a carbon challenge into an opportunity became the defining decision of his career.

description: The host speaks with business leaders and policymakers about their decision-making processes, including discussions of risk, doubt and conviction.

title: CNBC Innovation Lab
description: Examining how artificial intelligence is reshaping the labor market and society, particularly for younger workers entering an AI-driven world.
